summary: Verified the two Source-of-Supply picker bug fixes and the scrap-calc RM-classification refinement. BACKEND 20/20 pytest pass (/app/backend/tests/test_scrap_classification.py): scrap-calc/MAZ42117272-TA -> available, rm HRCOIL1.9X80.5 ('HR COIL 1.9mm X 80.5mm'), gross 0.49 / net 0.19 / scrap_per_unit 0.3, scrap_family exactly {Iron Scrap, IRON-SCR}; scrap-calc/632163-1 -> available:false, reason 'No raw-material (mass-based) BOM component found for this item' with no Zinc leakage (Zinc correctly excluded from RM candidacy); unit-level parametrised checks of _classify_scrap_family for CDA/BRASS->BRASS-SCR, COPPER->COPPSC, ALUMINIUM->ALU-SCRAP, SS/STAINLESS->SSSCRAP, CR->CR-SCRAP, HR/STEEL/FLAT->IRON-SCR and _pick_rm_item (Zinc excluded even when largest, None when only Zinc, classified preferred over larger unclassified, largest-unclassified fallback); 401 without session; HTBS-SPAIN still returns the 2 flat combos [(HTBS-SPAIN_1,P2),(HTBS-SPAIN_2,P3)] with descriptions; open-lots / deviation-reasons / proposal-history all 200. FRONTEND (live, synthetic vms_session, deleted after test): BUG 1 FIXED - typing 'HTBS-SPAIN' and pressing Tab (no manual Site typed) shows the picker with 'HTBS-SPAIN_1 - HTBS SPEAKER STAND BLACK (Site P2)' pre-selected AND Site auto-fills to 'P2'. BUG 2 FIXED - opening the dropdown keeps the picker visible, selecting 'source-of-supply-option-HTBS-SPAIN_2-P3' updates Site to 'P3' immediately, and pressing Tab + moving the mouse away leaves the picker visible with the selection intact (Site still P3, trigger still HTBS-SPAIN_2). Regression smoke: Production Confirmation tab loads 113 reporting points / 100 lots, Confirm dialog for lot 24168 (632163-1) renders the component stock check (incl. ZINC-ING) and the new Zinc-excluded unavailable note, Confirmation History dialog (1 row) and Manage Reasons dialog (12 reasons) both open/close fine, zero console errors. MAZ42117272-TA still has no open lot in SAP, so its scrap-calc UI block could not be exercised - verified via API instead. ONE PRE-EXISTING DEFECT STILL OPEN (iteration_84 action item 3, not fixed this pass): switching Product ID while a Site is already auto-filled sends the stale site_id and the picker silently disappears.

minor.issue: Response dict literal defines 'scrap_per_unit_kg' twice (server.py lines 659 and 661) - harmless duplicate key, but dead code that should be removed.

Unknown/mismatched site_id returns 200 with options:[] (verified: MAZ42117272-TA?site_id=P3 -> {options:[]}) which the UI cannot distinguish from 'material has no models at all'. Carried over from iteration_83/84.

integration_issues.flow: Change Product ID after a Site was auto-filled (Create Production Order tab)
integration_issues.issue: STILL OPEN from iteration_84. checkSourceOfSupply() (ProductionConfirmationPage.js line 417) still passes site_id when siteId is non-empty. Reproduced: select HTBS-SPAIN_2 (Site auto-fills P3), then type 'MAZ42117272-TA' and Tab -> lookup requests ?site_id=P3, backend returns options:[], picker disappears entirely and the stale wrong Site 'P3' is left in the field, so a Create would be submitted for the wrong site. Fix: drop site_id from the product-blur lookup, or clear Site when the new material has no combo at the current site.

action_items: Drop site_id from the product-blur source-of-supply lookup (or clear the Site field when the new material has no combo at the current Site) - the picker still vanishes with a stale wrong Site when the user switches material after an auto-fill.
Remove the duplicated 'scrap_per_unit_kg' key in the scrap-calc response dict (server.py ~line 661).

Harden _classify_scrap_family keyword matching to token/word-boundary matching - bare substrings 'CR', 'SS', 'CU', 'ALU' produce false positives (e.g. 'SCREW' and 'MICRO' contain CR, 'PRESSED'/'CROSS' contain SS, 'SECURE'/'CUT' contain CU, 'VALUE' contains ALU), which would label a plain steel part as CR/SS scrap.
critical_code_review_comments: The stale-closure fix is correct: checkSourceOfSupply() now reads options[idx].site_id from the freshly fetched array, and the Site input no longer has an onBlur handler, so the picker can never re-trigger its own fetch - both verified live.

SCRAP_FAMILY_RULES uses unanchored substring matching on a concatenated 'product_id description' string; rule ordering saves the known cases but it is fragile for new materials - use tokenised/regex word-boundary matching.
get_scrap_calc is still `async def` doing synchronous pymongo find_one calls (blocks the event loop) - same note as iteration_85, still unaddressed.
server.py is now 3463 lines and ProductionConfirmationPage.js 851 lines - both well past the 700-line guideline; the production-confirmation endpoints and CreateOrderTab are natural split points.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the 3 fixes under test (1 pre-existing, previously reported integration defect still open)

seed_data_creation: Reused /app/backend/tests/_setup_test_session.py to mint a synthetic Entra session (auth_users/auth_sessions, qa.scrapcalc@example.test, super_admin) for API + UI auth; deleted with --cleanup after testing. No SAP writes - no Create Production Order and no Post Confirmation was ever submitted (every dialog closed with Cancel).
test_credentials: No end-user login; Entra SSO simulated via a temporary Mongo auth_sessions doc + vms_session cookie (python /app/backend/tests/_setup_test_session.py [--cleanup]).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both picker bugs (auto-fill on lookup, picker resetting on interaction) are confirmed FIXED live - no need to retest unless CreateOrderTab changes again. Remaining known gap is the stale site_id on product switch (line 417). MAZ42117272-TA still has no open/all production lot in SAP, so the scrap-calc 'available' UI block can only be exercised by temporarily setting component_master.net_weight_kg on another material (see iteration_85's _temp_net_weight.py) - the API path is covered by tests/test_scrap_classification.py. Writing files under /app/backend triggers a uvicorn reload and ~60s of ingress 502s: write first, wait, then run pytest. Lot list takes 30-60s to populate; wait for [data-testid=lot-row-0] with a 90s timeout before clicking confirm-button-0.
rca_of_the_issue: No new product defect. Fix 1 works because the site is now read from the freshly fetched `options` array instead of the just-reset `sosOptions` state; fix 2 works because the Site input's onBlur no longer re-invokes checkSourceOfSupply (which used to reset sosOptions/selectedSosKey and, with the stale-closure bug, leave the picker empty). The still-open picker-disappears-on-material-switch case has a different root cause: the lookup query still includes the previously auto-filled site_id, and the backend legitimately returns zero combos for that site.
